summary: Kern County lookout on Sunday Peak in the Greenhorn Mountains, staffed in the 1920s and 1930s and burned by the Forest Service in 1954; a public trail now reaches the summit.

notes_for_editor: Dates conflict. (1) Build: a 1920 district newsletter item (via the Forest Lookouts page) describes a working lookout and cabin before the 1921 date given by SummitPost and the Tobias history. (2) End: SummitPost and the Tobias history give 1935 for the switch to Tobias Peak, but a June 1936 item names the Sunday Peak lookout, so 1935 may be early. (3) Burn: 1954 per SummitPost and the Tobias history; a trail guide says destroyed in the 1950s. (4) Elevation: the trail guide gives the summit as 8,295 ft; a 1934 report gives the lookout as 8,200 ft. Record kind 'tower' matches the FFLA row and the trail guide, while the 1920s newspaper items describe a cabin. The Kern River trail update is dated June 2022 and the Wilderness Portal page is undated; check current trail status before recommending a visit. The Living New Deal Tobias Peak page returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Two web searches used.
